status_definitions.resolved: The original bounded issue was corrected and has cited implementation plus scoped evidence. This does not imply universal/platform/human acceptance.
status_definitions.improved: A demonstrated part is corrected or instrumented; an essential gap remains, or new Pass2 work awaits final validation.

status_definitions.unsupported_by_evidence: The original report identified a risk/observation; no current causal defect or controlled reproduction was established.
status_definitions.open: Original issue remains unresolved or final corrective validation is not yet available.
